constraints: no code, no POM, no behaviour change
do not add the pointer to other modules

decisions: skip_specs: true in .openspec.yaml - openspec validate rejects a zero-delta change without it, and inventing a requirement to satisfy the validator is what the template explicitly warns against
design.md written as an explicit 'not required, and here is why' rather than omitted, so a reader does not have to wonder whether it was skipped by accident
